company.description: Poth Labs provides an AI-native customer research platform that unifies conversations, feedback, and customer data into a single system of insight. The platform ingests inputs such as calls, tickets, CRM notes, surveys, in-app chats, documents, and product analytics to create a searchable customer brain. It uses adaptive LLM-powered surveys that tailor questions in real time to explore emerging themes. Responses are stored in a knowledge graph so AI agents can detect patterns, run thematic analysis, and perform hypothesis-driven root cause investigation. The system generates prioritized insights with supporting evidence and suggested actions. Poth Labs also creates targeted follow-up questions and surveys to close data gaps and validate hypotheses.
